verdict.rationale: The public www.sos.state.tx.us forms directory lists formation and registration forms, such as Form 205 and Form 401, each with a 'Form Instructions' link and a 'Form PDF Version'. The supplementary note states the full directory of fillable forms with instructions is downloadable without an account. Missing for 10: a hands-on download test confirming no login is required (the no-account point rests on a summary note, not a quoted page statement), and independent corroboration.
